northStar.name: The Swiss Score Sheet
northStar.summary: A paper-like training tool with printed structure, handwritten values, and realistic dice as the tactile focal object.

display.purpose: Final totals, handwritten score emphasis, and rare personal-moment numerals.

headline.purpose: Brand mark and strong structural anchors.

title.purpose: Buttons, section totals, and compact structural emphasis.

body.purpose: Feedback detail and general reading copy.

label.purpose: Stats, headers, scorecard labels, and uppercase utility text.

elevation.philosophy: Flat by default, with shadows reserved for dice and other directly manipulated objects.

principles: Use brief, physical motion that reinforces the tactile model.
Dice can own the most expressive motion in the system.

componentNotes.scorecard: Sticky printed ledger with heavy borders, section bars, subtotal rows, and handwritten numeric entries.
componentNotes.dice: Realistic tactile objects with the highest elevation and the clearest state motion in the system.
componentNotes.feedback: Inline teaching surface that opens beneath controls, never a modal.

do: Use spacing, margin rhythm, and border weight as primary hierarchy tools.
Reserve green and red for evaluative meaning.
dont: Do not make this feel like a casino interface.
Do not make this feel like a mobile game with gimmicks.
Do not make this feel like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Do not add glossy gamification or decorative effects that break the paper metaphor.
